strategies.name: support_bounce_scalp
element_inventory: TIMEFRAME: scalp on the 5-minute chart. Quote: "I'm going to show you how to scalp using the [5] minute chart ... I got the 5 minute chart".

PRECONDITION (opening delay): let the first 5-15 minutes after market open pass before timing entries, so support can establish. Quote: "time your entries once you have allowed the first 5 to 15 minutes to pass because it allows you to establish where support is at".

PRECONDITION / LEVEL-IDENTIFICATION: a support level must be established/identified before entering; find it via demand zones = price levels where the stock repeatedly bottoms and bounces. Quote: "first establish where your support level is at ... look and learn to find and spot the demand zones ... every time we get to this price the stock take off".
LEVEL / INDICATOR: 13 EMA is the primary (initial) support reference. Quote: "this 13 EMA operated as a initial support".

ENTRY (primary): go long when price wicks down to and bounces off the 13 EMA support. Quote: "this candle wick came down bounced off of that ... the stock came down and it hit right there that's our entry for a scalp".

EXIT (primary): exit into the up-move after a few green candles / at resistance. Quote: "one green candle two green candles three four we went here and that was your exit" / "you ride it to resistance and you exit".

RE-ENTRY (rinse-repeat): when price returns to the SAME support level, re-enter the identical scalp. Quote: "it came back down again boom same level you enter here" / "trades you can rinse and repeat".

VARIANT SUB-MECHANIC (deeper support): once the 13 EMA gives up its support status, enter on the bounce off the 200 EMA (deeper support level). Quote: "another quick Scout this one off a deeper support sitting at the 200 EMA once the 13 EMA gave up its support status".

BREAKDOWN-CONTINUATION play (directionally OPPOSITE to the long bounce; taught with a gestural exit): once the 200 EMA support is LOST, enter on the breakdown and ride the big move down, exiting at the extension. Quote: "this is the big move you guys really want to learn to catch ... once we lost the support of the 200 look at this move boom boom boom you want to exit right there ... you would enter here and you had that coming all the way down".

SELECTION / FREQUENCY bound: do NOT take every setup; take only one or two quality plays (or wait for a single setup and take just that one). Quote: "you don't have to take every one of these ... you can find one or two ... or you can wait for one and then take the trade there".
coaching_notes: "you get in and out you don't overstay your welcome you don't get greedy with these trades because they're intended for you to be quick intended for you to make your money in a short amount of time"
"be snipers guys one shot one kill something you can reload the clip do it time and time again"
"I often talk about easing and scaling up in size okay easing to your positions don't come in with all the money in your account don't come into the game with all the money in your buying power"
"look and learn to trade with small amounts learn to First establish how to get in and get out"
"you want to practice the habit of just getting in and out getting in and out getting in and out"
"the thing about it is managing your risk getting in getting out not over[staying] your welcome seeing profit and taking profit"
"give yourself Grace all of this that I teach comes with the learning curve yes it can change your life but first you got to be willing to put in the work"
"I want you to Perfect The Craft"
"I want you guys to give this a try on tomorrow take a quick small trade that you see at support sell right at resistance"
